commentary: I did not buy anything today, and the book stays fully in cash. The one idea I genuinely want is UnitedHealth, which just raised its full-year profit forecast after a large beat and has no earnings report for another three months - but it jumped 3.5% today, and I would rather buy it on a quiet pullback to about $430 than chase the third strong day, so I have written that level down and will act on it. Being flat with a shortlist and specific prices is the strategy working, not the strategy stalling.
